'''Devil Stars''' are capsules from '''Update 9''' that grant the player a '''random mythic unit''' from Update 9 and can be obtained in 2 ways:

*From '''Devil Contracts''', with the higher the difficulty the higher chance to receive a Devil Star.
* Can be purchased from Makimo for 1000 Bullets

== Trivia ==
<blockquote>Most of these characters introduced new mechanics to the game as:

* [[Angel]] and [[Angel (Devil)]] using base hp to attack,

* [[Akin]] and [[Akin (Contract)]] having two attack modes that could be switched,

* [[Power (Fiend)]] having a bleed amplification debuff to make enemies take more bleed damage,

* [[Hime (Ghost)]] both attacking itself, and being able to summon a creature with its ability. 
</blockquote><blockquote>
